title: Sonny's Cozy Quokka Bedtime Tales
intro: Sonny's Cozy Quokka Bedtime Tales. Calm, gentle bedtime stories that help little ones drift off to sleep.
outro: Fourteen stories and counting, with new tales all the time. Subscribe, snuggle in tonight, and sweet dreams, little one.

text: Meet Sunny. A kind little quokka who wanders the moonlit Australian bush.
Each night, she meets a new sleepy friend. A round wombat, tucked in his cosy burrow.
A fluffy koala, dozing high in the gum trees.
A little penguin, waddling home across the silver sand.
And a wise old owl, who watches over the night.
Soft watercolour pictures. A gentle voice. And quiet lullaby music.
